7:21.en: All flesh that moved on the earth had perished, among birds and livestock and wild animals and among every swarming thing that swarms on the earth, and all humankind.

7:22.en: Everything that had the breath of the spirit of life in its nostrils, of all that was on dry land, died.

7:23.en: He wiped out every living thing that was on the surface of the ground, from humans to animals, to crawling things, and to the birds of the sky; they were wiped out from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.

7:24.en: The waters prevailed over the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

7:3.en: Also of the birds of the sky, seven each, male and female, to keep seed alive across the face of all the earth.

7:4.en: For in seven more days I will make it rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe out every living thing that I have made from the face of the ground.

7:5.en: Noah did according to all that the LORD had commanded him.

7:6.en: Now Noah was six hundred years old when the flood came, water upon the earth.

7:7.en: Noah went into the ark, and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him, because of the waters of the flood.

7:8.en: Of the clean animals, and of the animals that are not clean, and of the birds, and of everything that creeps on the ground,

7:9.en: two by two they came to Noah into the ark, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.

8:1.en: God remembered Noah and every living creature and all the domestic animals that were with him in the ark, and God made a wind pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.

8:10.en: He waited another seven days, and again he sent the dove away from the ark.

8:11.en: The dove came to him at evening time, and there in her beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters had abated from the earth.

8:12.en: He waited another seven days and sent the dove away, and she did not return to him any more.

8:13.en: In the six hundred and first year, in the first month, on the first of the month, the waters dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and there the surface of the ground had dried up.

8:14.en: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

8:15.en: Then God spoke to Noah, saying:

8:16.en: Go out of the ark, you and your wife, your sons and your sons' wives with you.

8:17.en: Bring out with you every living creature that is with you, of all flesh, birds and animals and everything that creeps on the earth, and let them breed abundantly on the earth and be fruitful and multiply on the earth.

8:18.en: So Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives.

8:19.en: All the animals, all the creeping things, and all the birds, everything that moves on the earth, went out of the ark by their kinds.

8:2.en: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the sky were shut, and the rain from the sky was held back.

8:20.en: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD, and he took some of every clean animal and every clean bird and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

8:21.en: The LORD smelled the soothing aroma, and the LORD said to himself, "I will never again curse the ground because of the human, for the inclination of the human heart is evil from his youth; and I will never again strike down every living thing as I have done."

8:22.en: For as long as the earth lasts, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease.

8:3.en: The waters withdrew from the earth steadily, and the waters decreased at the end of a hundred and fifty days.

8:4.en: The ark came to rest in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.

8:5.en: The waters continued to diminish steadily until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains became visible.

8:6.en: At the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made.

8:7.en: He sent out the raven, and it went back and forth until the waters had dried from off the earth.

8:8.en: Then he sent the dove away from him, to see whether the waters had abated from the surface of the ground.

8:9.en: But the dove found no resting place for the sole of her foot, and she returned to him, to the ark, for there was water over the surface of all the earth. So he stretched out his hand, took her, and brought her to him into the ark.

9:1.en: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth."

9:10.en: and with every living creature that is with you, among the birds, among the livestock, and among every animal of the earth that is with you, from all that came out of the ark, to every animal of the earth.

9:11.en: I will establish my covenant with you: never again will any flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood, and never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.

9:12.en: Then God said: This is the sign of the covenant that I am giving between me and you and between every living creature that is with you, for everlasting generations.

9:13.en: I have now set my bow in the cloud, and it will become a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

9:14.en: When I bring clouds over the earth, the bow will appear in the cloud.

9:15.en: I will remember my covenant that is between me and you and between every living creature among all flesh, and never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all flesh.

9:16.en: The bow will be in the cloud, and I will see it, to remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living being, among all flesh that is on the earth.

9:17.en: God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth."

9:18.en: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham was the father of Canaan.

9:19.en: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was dispersed.

9:2.en: The fear and dread of you shall be upon every animal of the earth and upon every bird of the sky, upon everything that crawls on the ground and upon all the fish of the sea; into your hand they are given.

9:20.en: Noah, a man of the soil, began and planted a vineyard.

9:21.en: He drank some of the wine, became drunk, and uncovered himself inside his tent.

9:22.en: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father's nakedness and told his two brothers outside.

9:23.en: Shem and Japheth took the garment and laid it on both their shoulders, and they walked backward and covered their father's nakedness, and their faces were backward, and they did not see their father's nakedness.

9:24.en: Noah woke from his wine and learned what his youngest son had done to him.

9:25.en: He said, "Cursed be Canaan; a slave among slaves shall he be to his brothers."

9:26.en: He said, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem, and may Canaan be a slave to them."

9:27.en: May God enlarge Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Shem; and may Canaan be a slave to them.

9:28.en: After the flood Noah lived three hundred and fifty years.

9:29.en: All the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years, and he died.

9:3.en: Every moving thing that is alive shall be food for you; as with the green plants, I have given you everything.

9:4.en: Only flesh with its life, its blood, you shall not eat.

9:5.en: But your blood, for your lives, I will demand; from every animal I will demand it, and from the human, from each man for his brother, I will demand the life of the human.

9:6.en: Whoever sheds the blood of the human, by the human his blood shall be shed; for in the image of God He made the human.

9:7.en: As for you, be fruitful and multiply; swarm over the earth and multiply in it.

9:8.en: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:

9:9.en: As for me, I am establishing my covenant with you and with your offspring after you,
